data.name: Summayyah
data.long_meaning: Summayyah is derived from the Arabic root 'S-M-W' meaning 'high' or 'elevated'. It signifies a lofty status or position.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, the name Summayyah is associated with a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), Summayyah bint Khayyat, known for her courage and faith.
data.numerology_meaning: Signifies new beginnings, creativity, and independence.

in_arabic.name: سمية
in_arabic.meaning: السمية تعني الرفعة و العلو في المعنى و الدلالة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم سمية مشتق من الجذر السين-ميم-ياء و هو يدل على الرفعة و العلو في المعنى و الدلالة، و يعتبر من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني سامية و رفيعة في الثقافة الإسلامية، و قد ورد ذكر اسم سمية في بعض المصادر التاريخية الإسلامية كإحدى أسماء النساء الصالحات

in_urdu.name: سمية
in_urdu.meaning: سمية کا مطلب ہے شرف و منزلت، نام کی عظمت
in_urdu.long_meaning: سمية نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جو کہ سین-میم-یاہ کے جذر سے بنا ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے شرف و منزلت، نام کی عظمت، یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان، جہاں یہ سادگی اور گہرے معنی کے لئے جانا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: सुम्मयाह
in_hindi.meaning: सुम्मयाह का अर्थ है गरिमा और उच्चता
in_hindi.long_meaning: सुम्मयाह नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जो सिन-ميم-या के मूल से लिया गया है, और इसका अर्थ है गरिमा और उच्चता, यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण है, विशेष रूप से भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, जहां यह सादगी और गहरे अर्थ के लिए जाना जाता है

in_pashto.name: سميه
in_pashto.meaning: سميه د لوړتوب او عزت معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: سميه نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چي د سين-ميم-ياء د ريښې څخه جوړ شوی دی، او د لوړتوب او عزت معنی لري، دا نوم د افغان او پښتن مسلمانانو په دود کې مهم دی، چي د سادگي او ژورې معنی لپاره پيژندل شوی دی

in_english.name: Summayyah
in_english.meaning: Summayyah means exaltation, elevation, or high esteem
in_english.long_meaning: Summayyah originates from the Arabic root 'sin-mim-yaa', signifying elevation, high esteem, or exaltation, it holds a revered place in Islamic tradition, symbolizing spiritual upliftment and moral excellence, historically, the name is associated with one of the earliest converts to Islam, Summayyah bint al-Khamis, embodying courage and conviction

data.cultural_impact: Summayyah is a unique and beautiful Arabic name, particularly significant in the Islamic world. Its meaning, derived from the Arabic root 'S-M-W' meaning 'high' or 'elevated', evokes connotations of status, achievement, and pride. In Islamic culture, the name Summayyah is often given to girls as a sign of aspiration for greatness and success. It is also a reminder of the importance of striving for excellence in all aspects of life, as encouraged by Islamic teachings.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Summayyah holds deep spiritual significance within Islamic tradition. It serves as a reminder of the Almighty Allah's infinite mercy and compassion towards His creation. The name Summayyah also symbolizes the concept of taqwa, or god-consciousness, in Islam. Just as Summayyah connotes a high or elevated status, a person who possesses taqwa strives to maintain a close and pure relationship with Allah, constantly seeking His pleasure and guidance. The name Summayyah, therefore, embodies the ideas of attaining spiritual height through devotion and good deeds.
